summary: Make terminal attachment and inventory focus tests portable and independently buildable

replay.detail: Test configuration only; no replay changes.

rules.detail: No rule, checkpoint or digest changes.

compatibility.detail: Attachment tests configure read timeouts before discarding stale streams, avoiding macOS socket-option errors after closure while preserving EOF assertions. The TUI dev-dependency explicitly enables daemon test support so its tests compile independently. The older-member inventory test waits for live UI, palette transitions and completed reads instead of injecting keys after a fixed startup delay; its PTY helper wakes on screen output. Production behavior and dependencies are unchanged.
